text:
alex: Heads up — quiet window tonight 02:00–04:00 UTC. Plan: rolling NIC micro-reboots + queued-drain to reduce thermal spikes on az6/az7. Expect brief queue-throttle behavior (1–3m per node) and staggered backfill. I'll post runbook updates. :wave:

morgan: Which pools are in-scope? priority tenants? :question:

alex: in-scope = gpu-pools: saturn, zephyr (az6/az7). Priority mapping: customer-tier=enterprise pinned, no eviction for pinned. We'll reserve 12% capacity for canaries/backfill. Noncritical spot-backed jobs will be preempted.

sara: Cost hit estimate? we have burst on-demand fallback >30m might spike costs.

alex: estimate ~ $1.1k-$1.6k for US-west surge depending on spot backfill. We'll enable cost cap / alerting during window and tag spend: "maintenance/2024-11-08-queue-throttle"

linh: I'll handle status page and customer comms. Who takes monitoring runbook? :raising_hand:

jay: I can own monitoring. I'll watch GPU util, net tx drops, and scheduling backlog. Setting alerts now.

alex: preheat/backfill steps:
```
# drain command used for node cohort
kubectl drain node-<cohort> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m
# backfill: backfill-manager --pool saturn --reserve 12%
```
We'll stagger 5 nodes at a time with 2m gap to avoid global queue pileup.

morgan: Any KV-cache seeding plan to avoid cold-start token regen?

alex: yes — prefix cache seeding for hot tenants + kv-prime job @ 01:30 UTC. That should cut regen by ~65%.

dev-bot: Maintenance window scheduled by ops: 2024-11-08 02:00–04:00 UTC — ticket #INC-5234. :information_source:

sara: If we see >5% sustained 95th latency increase, rollback and pause. Agree?

jay: agree. I'll escalate to oncall if thresholds hit.

linh: Status page updated. Customer email draft under /docs/maintenance/drafts — LMK for edits.

alex: Thanks — will post live updates in this thread during ops. :thumbsup:
